verdict.rationale: The evidence describes llamafile as a single self-contained executable per model, with weights and default arguments baked into each file [llamafile-docs-8]. Nothing documents a central place to manage downloaded models, saved prompts, or per-model configurations. Community comments reinforce the one-binary-per-model design [llamafile-comm-9], and nothing points to a model library or prompt manager, so this applicable local-LLM tooling axis is unevidenced.
